Container.Name: freemkv-library
Container.Overview:
freemkv-library is the freemkv web server: insert a disc and it rips the main movie automatically to MKV (DVD, Blu-ray and 4K UHD), with tolerant multipass recovery for damaged discs. A browser UI shows live progress, settings and history, and the Library tab manages the MKVs and ISOs you already have.
Privileged is REQUIRED: without it the container starts but detects no optical drives ("No drives detected"). Blu-ray and UHD need decryption keys (see https://freemkv.org/docs/decryption-keys/); DVDs need none. Everything else is configured in the web UI (Settings) and saved to /config/settings.json.
Container.Requires: An optical drive (internal SATA or USB) attached to the Unraid server.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: settings.json, per-drive logs and (by default) the keys directory.

Config.Name: Output
Config.Description: Where finished MKV / M2TS files land (output_dir in Settings).

Config.Name: Staging
Config.Description: Intermediate ISO + mapfile during a multipass rip. Needs room for a full disc (up to ~100 GB for UHD); a cache/SSD pool is best.

Config.Name: Keys
Config.Description: Decryption key database (KEYDB.cfg) so keys persist across updates. See https://freemkv.org/docs/decryption-keys/

Config.Name: Host /dev
Config.Description: Live host device tree: finds the optical drives (/dev/sr*, /dev/sg*) and survives USB re-enumeration. Do not change.

Config.Name: Host /sys
Config.Description: Read-only sysfs, used for drive discovery. Do not change.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the server binds inside the container. Leave at 8080 and change the Web UI port mapping instead.

Config.Name: AUTORIP_DIR
Config.Description: Where settings.json and logs are stored inside the container.

Config.Name: AUTORIP_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity (tracing filter). Use autorip=debug for troubleshooting.

Config.Name: NFS_HOST
Config.Description: Optional in-container NFS mount: NFS server. Set with NFS_EXPORT and NFS_MOUNTPOINT (and then point output_dir at the mountpoint).

Config.Name: NFS_EXPORT
Config.Description: Optional: export path on the NFS server, e.g. /mnt/user/media.

Config.Name: NFS_MOUNTPOINT
Config.Description: Optional: where to mount the NFS share inside the container.
